subject: School Reopening and COVID-19 Safety Protocols
overview: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent outlined health and safety measures for the 2021-2022 school year and announced upcoming student start dates. The district confirmed mandatory masking and the continuation of its COVID-19 testing program.

items.title: COVID-19 Safety and Testing
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent announced mandatory masking for all students and staff and the continuation of the district's COVID-19 testing partnership with Tufts University and Armstrong Ambulance.

items.title: Vaccination and Start Dates
items.summary: The Superintendent encouraged community vaccination and announced school start dates of August 31 for grades 1-12 and September 8 for kindergarten.
